dialogues.speaker: Zaitseva
dialogues.text: Indeed! The composition is rough yet somehow exquisite, the form chaotic but strangely ordered — Aino has managed to redefine the entire meaning of scrap using a language purely her own!

dialogues.speaker: Zaitseva
dialogues.text: *sigh* If only the world were left in the hands of people like us! More's the pity, it's always the uncultured philistines who rise to the top...
